reasoning: Hantavirus is rare (~10–50 US cases/year), providing minimal commercial incentive. No hantavirus vaccine is currently in Phase 3 trials or close to FDA submission; full approval by end 2026 would require near-complete pivotal data and review, which is extremely improbable given typical vaccine development timelines.
evidence_points: No publicly known Phase 3 trial for a hantavirus vaccine in the US
Hantavirus incidence is very low, reducing urgency and funding
Vaccine approval typically requires large efficacy trials that take years
sources_consulted: General knowledge of hantavirus epidemiology and vaccine development status
